```sql
SELECT poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p,
     (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bill Harris Arena%' LIMIT 1) AS r
WHERE p.amenity = 'museum'
  AND p.poi_name ILIKE '%aerospace%'
  AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography, 10000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> r.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    ST_Azimuth(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS bearing_radians,
    degrees(ST_Azimuth(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)) AS bearing_degrees,
    ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM 
    pois p
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Pinellas Park%' LIMIT 1) r
WHERE 
    p.poi_name ILIKE '%railway museum%' 
    AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
ORDER BY 
    p.geometry::geography <-> r.geometry::geography
LIMIT 1;
```
